company.name: MedXT
company.shortDescription: MedXT is a cloud-based RIS/PACS that helps you and way to manage medical images online.
company.description: San Francisco-based MedXT brings the power of RIS/PACS to clinics and practices by enabling radiologists and practitioners to evaluate, diagnose and treat patients remotely using its easy to use, flexible universal image viewer. MedXT offers an FDA-cleared (510k) viewer and efficient image-sharing network that allows outpatient clinics and primary care providers to not only minimize imaging storage and maintenance costs but also to satisfy the access requirements of patients and their community providers.  For more information, please visit www.medxt.com.
